priority.summary: Fermi Inc. discloses the immediate resignation of director Miles Everson, effective July 10, 2026, due to a disagreement over access to company books and records and the delegation of responsibility for overseeing financing transactions to the Finance Committee. Amazon slumped 7.3% as the firm reported greater capital spending than anticipated, while Intel plunged 23% after its revenue forecast missed analysts’ estimates. Bloomberg's Ruhell Amin reports. (Source: Bloomberg)

general.title: BP Profit Hits 18-Year High as Oil Refining Margins Surge
general.summary: BP Plc said profit surged to the highest in 18 years as soaring refining margins boosted earnings, while a sharp drop in net debt moved the British energy major closer to a position where it could restart buybacks.

general.title: UK House Prices Stagnant as Loan Costs Bite, Nationwide Says
general.summary: UK house prices failed to grow in October, according to one of the country’s largest mortgage lenders, as surging mortgage costs squeezed prospective buyers.

general.title: Jio Boosts India to Top of Global IPO Market With Record October
general.summary: India was the world’s top market for initial public offerings in October, thanks to a record month driven by the blockbuster share sale of Jio Platforms Ltd.

general.title: FTSE 100 Live: UK Stocks Set to Outperform as Tech Sells Off
GLP-1 Demand Boosts Dis-Chem’s South Africa Pharmacy Revenue
general.summary: Dis-Chem Pharmacies Ltd. said surging demand for GLP-1 medicines is helping drive double-digit growth in its dispensary revenue as South Africans increasingly turn to the expensive drugs used to treat diabetes and obesity.

general.title: Varkey: AI to Help Bridge Teacher Shortage Gap
general.summary: Ongoing regional conflict is testing the UAE's post-pandemic boom and the new school year is offering another gauge of the country's resilience. Dubai-based private school operator GEMS Education plans to launch a school model next January, which combines AI-powered, self-paced learning with teacher mentoring. Dino Varkey, Group CEO, GEMS Education spoke to Bloomberg’s Abeer Abu Omar on the AI deployment. (Source: Bloomberg)

general.title: Tokyo Electron’s Outlook Beats on Surging AI Chip Spending
general.summary: Tokyo Electron Ltd. gave a better-than-expected annual outlook in a reflection of accelerated spending by chipmakers to meet AI hardware demand.

general.title: French Economy Unexpectedly Shrinks as Headwinds Strengthen
general.summary: France’s economy unexpectedly contracted and inflation neared a three-year high, adding to headaches that already include surging borrowing costs, violent protests and political and budgetary uncertainty.

general.title: Hyosung, Siemens partner on digital power grid and AI data center solutions - The Korea Herald
SNB Reports Nine-Month Profit on Foreign Currencies and Gold
general.summary: The Swiss National Bank reported a solid nine-month profit thanks to its foreign-currency portfolio and gold holdings.

general.title: ECB’s Moulin Sees Policy as Measured With Most Prices Stable
general.summary: The European Central Bank is responding in a measured way to inflation as most prices are stable and pressures are largely imported rather than driven by domestic factors, Governing Council member Emmanuel Moulin said.

general.title: Japanese Stocks Signal Confidence Over Faster BOJ ETF Sales
general.summary: Japanese equities shrugged off the Bank of Japan’s surprise move to accelerate selling of its massive holdings of exchange-traded funds, as investors showed confidence in the market’s ability to absorb the extra supply.

general.title: Spotify targets 2027 launch for AI remix service, FT reports - Reuters
How Jio Fueled India’s Digital Boom
general.summary: With cheap data that triggered a price war in India's telecom market, Jio helped push the country's internet subscriptions past 1.1 billion. Billionaire Ambani's digital venture transformed how people learn, pay, shop and invest and even helped fuel India’s startup boom. (Source: Bloomberg)

general.title: How One Country Became the Unlikely Crossroads of the Global A.I. Boom - The New York Times
Bitcoin Stolen in Binance Hack Is Likely ‘Gone,’ Ballet Says
general.summary: The Bitcoin stolen in the hack of Binance’s crypto exchange will probably be impossible to recover, according to Bobby Lee, founder of digital-asset hardware wallet company Ballet Global Inc.

general.title: Japan to Scale Back Fuel Subsidies as Iran War Costs Mount
general.summary: Japanese motorists are poised for a more expensive commute as the government scales back generous fuel subsidies that have helped cushion consumers from the impact of the US-Iran war.

general.title: Inside Shanghai’s Changing Nightlife Scene
general.summary: Shanghai's sprawling INS Land, dubbed a Disneyland for adults, has 20 venues under one roof. It offers young adults an affordable way to go out as China’s post-Covid economic recovery proves rockier than expected. Allen Wan takes us inside. (Source: Bloomberg)

general.title: BOJ Holds Rate as Underlying Inflation Hits Target
general.summary: The Bank of Japan kept its benchmark rate at 1.25%, while signaling that underlying inflation has reached its 2% target for the first time, taking more than a decade to achieve. (Source: Bloomberg)

general.title: Murata Invests $6.4 Billion to Double MLCC Output for AI
general.summary: Murata Manufacturing Co. will invest ¥1 trillion ($6.4 billion) over five years to more than double sales of its capacitors in a bid to cement its lead and meet unprecedented demand from AI data center operators.

general.title: Britain’s Plan to Tax Its Way Out of Debt Tests the Limits
general.summary: Britain was singled out for praise by the International Monetary Fund this month for the boldest deficit-reduction plan of any Group of Seven nation. Bolder still is its decision to deliver the whole squeeze with higher taxes, as economists warn that Chancellor of the Exchequer John Healey is pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

general.title: Envision's Zheng on China's AI Data Center Buildout
general.summary: Ricky Zheng, General Manager of AIDC at Envision Group, says the company plans to develop data centres around the world powered by renewable energy, with Latin America, Southern Europe and Africa emerging as ideal locations. He speaks exclusively on "Bloomberg: The China Show". (Source: Bloomberg)

Binance Hack 'Not End of World,' Says Crypto Pioneer
general.summary: China crypto pioneer Bobby C. Lee, the founder and CEO of Ballet, puts into context the suspected hack of world's biggest crypto exchange Binance and talks about lessons for investors. (Source: Bloomberg)

general.title: UN Delays Bangladesh, Nepal Exit From Least Developed Status
general.summary: The United Nations gave Bangladesh and Nepal three more years before they leave the Least Developed Nation category, allowing them to retain trade and financing benefits as both economies face pressures from global and domestic challenges.

general.title: In China, the War on Mosquitoes Has Entered the A.I. Era - The New York Times

Envision to Complete Massive Inner Mongolia Data Center by 2028
general.summary: Chinese renewable energy firm Envision Group plans to finish building its Galaxy Campus data center in Inner Mongolia by the end of 2028, with capacity to eventually reach 3 gigawatts.

general.title: BOJ Inflation Target Signal Supports Yen Gains, Strategists Say
general.summary: The yen broadly held its gains after the Bank of Japan left its benchmark rate unchanged in an 8-1 vote, while signaling underlying inflation had reached its 2% target and opening the door to a December hike. The BOJ also accelerated the pace of ETF sales to about ¥860 billion ($5.5 billion) a year.

general.title: RBNZ Likely to Raise Key Rate at Next Two Meetings, Survey Shows
general.summary: New Zealand’s central bank will likely raise its key interest rate at its next two meetings in December and February before pausing, economists say.
